name: Luminaires
shortDescription: Explosion-proof and waterproof luminaires for hazardous industrial areas — the category Baliga pioneered in India in 1962.

name: Control Gear
shortDescription: Flameproof control gear for hazardous-area lighting and power circuits.

name: Switches
shortDescription: Explosion-proof switches rated for use in Zone 1 & 2 hazardous locations.

name: Cable Glands
shortDescription: Flameproof cable glands for secure cable entry into Ex-rated enclosures.

name: Junction Boxes
shortDescription: Cast and FRP junction boxes, including multiway variants, for hazardous-area wiring.

name: Control Stations
shortDescription: Flameproof control stations for local equipment operation in classified hazardous zones.

name: Accessories
shortDescription: Starters, plug & socket units, heaters, purging systems, and monitoring accessories for hazardous-area installations.

name: Flow Measurement Equipment
shortDescription: Orifice plates and flow measuring equipment for potentially explosive industrial areas.
